description:
Use our code FERN10 to get 10% off your Manta Sleep masks and the new White Noise Machine here: https://fern.deals/manta/FERN10 (ad)

Join our newsletter: https://roots.watchfern.com/

Pokémon cards are big business these days. Some are SO rare they seem too good to be true. Are they? This is the internet’s biggest Pokémon detective story.

Special thanks to Scott Mastromatteo, levu12/Leo Vu, Emory @ Pokumon.com, Brad Chacos, Cliff Braun, and the EFA.

Check out David Howard's article: https://www.popularmechanics.com/culture/a65054664/pokemon-card-authentication-scam/

Corrections:
19:51: We’re sorry, Californians. “Palo Alto” is pronounced correctly later on in the video. The VO was done by a Midwesterner, who has been appropriately disciplined.
21:27: The word “steganography” was used correctly by the writer, but unfortunately mispronounced by the voice-over artist. Both are named in the credits.
29:50: 500 in base-6 does not equal 5 in decimal—this is is a typo. The correct base-6 number here is 005, as the 7-3-2 boxes indicate.


Sources:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MsMgNLbERyPZ_KL-INaw5rzqtvqh4uPh/edit
